author: Blueprint — AI-assisted original imagery
processing: Original alpha preserved; four 1254px originals resized to 512px WebP quality 90. Cloud runtime applies local deformation and density evolution. Clear-sun runtime keeps the disc stable while atmospheric sectors extend, lose density and resolve. Posters are rendered from the same runtime.

sources.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: reusable atmospheric cloud texture for an animated weather object. Create ONE sublime isolated cumulus cloud, ultra photorealistic, like an exquisite atmospheric photograph cut out on a truly transparent alpha background. Wide asymmetric cloud silhouette, luminous ivory billowing cauliflower towers above, beautiful soft cool blue-grey shadows below, lit from upper left, astonishing fine wispy vapor at the edge, volumetric light scattering. Cloud fills central 80 percent of width and central 55 percent of height of a square image. Nothing else: no sun, no rain, no sky, no horizon, no text, no drop shadow, no border, no checkerboard baked into image. It is vapor, not stone, not sculpted clay. Soft dense coherent central body with airy translucent edges. One isolated cloud only. Save image for use as a project asset.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: reusable atmospheric cloud material for animated weather. ONE isolated wide asymmetric cumulus cloud on truly TRANSPARENT alpha background. Sublime hand-painted gouache and watercolor cloud, sophisticated editorial illustration, luminous pearl ivory highlights, muted lavender and dusty ultramarine shadow planes, warm cream softly feathered edges, visible delicate brush marks and pigment pooling. Sculptural fluffy vapor with several billowing towers but distinctly painted, NOT photorealistic, NOT a cartoon icon, NOT flat vector. Upper-left illumination. Fill central 80 percent width and central 55 percent height of square, keep wide transparent margins and fully visible entire cloud. No sky no sun no rain no ground no paper background no text no checkerboard. Exquisitely beautiful as an isolated reusable object.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: reusable weather-object material texture for a premium web component, square transparent PNG. Primary request: an isolated clear-weather sun as seen from Earth's lower atmosphere: soft white-gold disc partially veiled by luminous atmospheric haze, delicate irregular diffraction rays and subtle heat shimmer; unmistakably ordinary sunny weather, not the astronomical Sun. Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent; no sky rectangle, no ground, no clouds. Subject: one centered sun with a smooth overexposed disc, organic translucent halo and sparse refracted rays; no visible solar surface, no flames, no prominences, no space imagery. Style/medium: high-end photorealistic atmospheric optical effect, editorial weather photography/VFX material. Composition/framing: centered, disc about 42% of square width, halo within 72%, large transparent margin. Lighting/mood: elegant midday white-gold light, restrained amber at the outer haze, subtle bloom. Constraints: transparent alpha; no text, watermark, border, stars, planets, face, hard outline, repeated symmetric spokes; readable at 160 px. Avoid: astronomical solar texture, lava, fireball, explosion, fiery corona, emoji, clip-art, neon.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: reusable painted weather-object material for a premium web component, square transparent PNG. Primary request: an isolated clear-weather sun, painted with exceptional editorial gouache quality: warm luminous disc, layered translucent washes, irregular soft rays and a subtle atmospheric halo; ordinary sunny weather, not outer space. Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent; no sky rectangle, no ground, no clouds. Subject: one centered sun without a face, smooth glowing center with hand-painted tonal variation and sparse organic rays. Style/medium: sophisticated contemporary gouache and watercolor on transparent ground, visible pigment grain and dry-brush edges, museum-quality botanical/editorial illustration rather than children's clip-art. Composition/framing: centered; disc about 42% of square width, halo/rays within 72%, transparent margin. Lighting/mood: radiant white-gold center, ochre, saffron and restrained coral accents. Constraints: transparent alpha; no text, watermark, border, stars, planets, face, hard outline, repeated symmetric spokes; readable at 160 px. Avoid: emoji, flat yellow circle, childlike icon, vector clip-art, astronomical surface, flames, explosion, neon, perfectly symmetrical sunburst.
